bridge.rules: Chicago bridge: four deals, you (South) and North against West and East. Bid a contract (level 1 to 7 is tricks past six, in clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades or no trump); three passes after a bid end the auction. Declarer plays both hands, dummy goes down after the opening lead. Follow suit; the highest trump, else the highest card of the suit led, takes the trick. Game (100 trick points) is worth 300, or 500 vulnerable; slams and doubles score more, undertricks cost 50 or 100. The computers bid a natural system: 5-card majors, 15 to 17 NT, Stayman (2 clubs after 1NT). Tap a card to play it; when you are declarer, tap dummy’s cards too. Players can be any of the four seats: with two or more people in the Players rows, each sees only their own hand, behind a handoff.

canasta.rules: Two-handed Canasta against Zimi. Draw two cards, or take the discard pile; lay down melds of three or more of a rank; discard one card. Twos and jokers are wild (a meld needs two natural cards, at most three wild, never more wild than natural). Seven cards make a canasta: 500 pure, 300 mixed. Red threes score 100 each and are laid at once; black threes only go out. Your first meld needs 50 points (more as your score rises). The pile is frozen after a wild discard, or before you have melded: take it only with a natural pair matching the top card. Going out needs two canastas (100, or 200 if you laid everything in one turn). Pick cards by tapping them, then Meld, Discard or Take pile (or tap the stock to draw). Keys: D draw, T take, M meld, X discard, Esc clear. First to the goal wins.

gin.rules: Make sets (three or four of a rank) and runs (three or more of a suit, ace low). Each turn draw from the stock or take the top discard, then discard. When your deadwood (cards outside melds, face cards 10, ace 1) is 10 or less, select the card to discard and knock; with none, go gin. The other side lays off cards on your melds; if they end with as little or less, they undercut you for the difference plus 25. First to 100 wins, plus 100 for the game and 25 a hand won. Tap a card to select it, then Discard or Knock; tap the stock or discard pile to draw.
